# Mapping AI — DEPRECATED

This file has been superseded by `prompts/query_skill.md`.

**Do not edit this file.** Edit `query_skill.md` instead — it is the single shared
skill file used by both the Mapping tab (JOIN SQL generation) and the Report tab
(natural language → SQL).

`query_skill.md` covers everything this file had:
- Project / domain context       → "Domain Context" section
- Schema notes / JOIN hints      → "Known Table Relationships" section
- SQL style preferences          → "SQL Style Rules" section
- XML mapping rules              → "Mapping Query Rules" section
- Field name aliases             → "Field Name Aliases" (add to SQL Style Rules)

This file is kept only so existing code that falls back to it still works.
The runtime engine (`query_builder.py`) prefers `query_skill.md` over this file.
